name.ja: 30MM ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON RaD CC-2000 ORBITER ナイトフォール
name.en: 30MM ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON RaD CC-2000 ORBITER Nightfall

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが30 MINUTES MISSIONSシリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON" items are commercialized in the 30 MINUTES MISSIONS series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組立」「カスタム遊び」のもと、レイヴンが駆る劇中でも印象的なAC「ナイトフォール」が登場。
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," the impressive AC " Nightfall", driven by Raven, is now available.

description.ja: • 頭部、コア、腕部、脚部それぞれにシリーズ共通構造を採用し、ゲーム内同様に『アセンブル』をプラモデルで楽しめる。
description.en: • The head, core, arms, and legs each have a common structure in the series, allowing you to enjoy ``assemble'' with the plastic model just like in the game.

description.ja: • 両肩武器と一部左手武器の取り付けには3mmジョイントを採用し様々なアセンブルに対応可能。
description.en: • 3mm joints are used to attach both shoulder weapons and some left-handed weapons, allowing for a variety of assemblies.

description.ja: • 左手武器「PB-033M ASHMEAD」には射出状態を再現可能な差し替えパーツが付属。
description.en: • The left hand weapon "PB-033M ASHMEAD" comes with replacement parts that can reproduce the ejection state.

description.ja: • アサルトブースト時再現用の頭部パーツが付属。
description.en: • Includes head parts to recreate assault boost.

accessories.ja: ナイトフォール 武器×1式
PB-033M ASHMEAD 射出状態再現用パーツ×1式
accessories.en: PB-033M ASHMEAD injection state reproduction parts x 1 set
